name: image-upscaler-monorepo
description: Client-side image upscaling SDK (classical + local AI), framework agnostic.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/image-upscaler --noEmit && tsc -p packages/image-upscaler-react --noEmit && tsc -p examples/react --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @smartapp/image-upscaler && npm run build --workspace @smartapp/image-upscaler-react
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:demo && npm run test:e2e
